statement.text:
(Well-known problem). Let S be a connected orientable hyperbolic surface of
finite type and complexity at least 2. Does its mapping class group M CG(S) have a
non-elementary hyperbolic quotient?
    An affirmative answer is known when S is a closed genus-2 surface (https://
arxiv.org/pdf/2005.00567.pdf), and in the same paper it is shown that the answer
will be affirmative provided certain hyperbolic groups are residually finite. See also a
closely related question 16.108 about braid groups.                           M. Hagen
